title: reaping twice lists the worker on both reaps: the line is output only, it writes no event and nothing de-duplicates it across reaps
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, The v0.1.0 cut (the unlogged worker is output only)
intent: An unlogged worker is reported as one stdout line per reap, `unlogged worker: <evidence>`. It writes no registry event and is not remembered: the second reap lists the same worker again and the registry keeps its one launch line.

stdout.regex: (?m)^jitso reap: 0 launch\(es\) marked ended, 1 unlogged worker\(s\)$
(?m)^unlogged worker: worker term_rogue in run run_1 has no launch event$
(?m)^jitso reap: 0 launch\(es\) marked ended, 1 unlogged worker\(s\)$
(?m)^unlogged worker: worker term_rogue in run run_1 has no launch event$
